headline: God of War TV series recasts Kratos after actor injury
summary: The actor playing Kratos in the upcoming Amazon Prime Video series has sustained an injury, leading to a recasting of the iconic role.
details: The actor who was portraying Kratos in the "God of War" TV series has been replaced due to an injury sustained on set.
Ryan Hurst, who was previously cast as the Spartan warrior, will no longer be playing the role. The specific nature of his injury has not been disclosed.
This marks a significant change for the highly anticipated Amazon Prime Video adaptation of the popular PlayStation video game franchise.
Fans have been eagerly awaiting updates on the series, which aims to bring the epic Norse saga of Kratos and Atreus to the small screen.
